candidates.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow on November 12 for planned talks with Vladimir Putin following U.S.-mediated Russian-Ukrainian negotiations in Abu Dhabi. Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev met them at Vnukovo Airport. Their arrival was confirmed; the sources did not establish that the meeting with Putin had concluded.
candidates.title: U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow following Abu Dhabi negotiations

candidates.summary: At a November 12 news conference in Kuala Lumpur, Mongolian special envoy Zandanshatar Gombojav disclosed that Mongolia had sent Malaysia a diplomatic protest note on November 10 over the Altantuya Shaariibuu murder case. He called for review of a civil judgment, efforts to return a convicted officer from Australia, examination of potentially new evidence and a written response. The protest itself was sent earlier; the target-day development was its public disclosure.
candidates.title: Mongolian envoy discloses diplomatic protest over Altantuya murder case
